description: This line plot illustrates the Macro-F1 Score (%) as a function of the Number of tokens, comparing two configurations: “MATTER (ours)” and “w/o material information.” The x-axis, labeled “Number of tokens,” spans from approximately 0.6 to 1.4 and is presented on a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis, labeled “Macro-F1 Score (%)”, ranges from 48% to 58% and is also linearly scaled, with tick marks at intervals of 2%. The “MATTER (ours)” configuration is represented by a red line with circular markers and a solid line style; it begins at approximately 55.4% at 0.6 tokens, rises to a peak of 58.5% at 0.8 tokens, then declines to around 55.6% at 1.4 tokens. The “w/o material information” configuration is represented by a purple line with circular markers and a solid line style; it starts at approximately 52.4% at 0.6 tokens, rises to a peak of 56.8% at 1.2 tokens, then declines to approximately 51.8% at 1.4 tokens. Both lines exhibit shaded regions around them, indicating variability or confidence intervals, with the red region being lighter pink and the purple region being light purple.
